text: Now place the 5, 7, 9 or 11 clay lamps you got ready earlier in front of Ammavaru.
Remembering Ammavaru, light the lamps one by one.

Amma, we pray that along with the light of these lamps your grace reaches every corner of our home, and that everyone in our family is blessed with long life and good health, happiness, and wealth and prosperity.
Keep the lamps in front of Ammavaru for a little while and offer your namaskaram.
Then carefully carry the lit lamps and place them at the threshold of the house, in the puja room, in the hall and in other safe places.
Placing these lamps all through the home is an act of devotion: we are carrying Ammavaru's blessings to every corner of our home.
